name: singlet_spatial_preproc_image_cell_segmentation
title: Segment nuclei and cells in stain images
description: Assigns integer instance labels to nuclei and cells in a registered stain image, and writes cell polygons, centroids, areas and a calibrated per-cell confidence. The default method is the learned cellpose flow model; watershed is a training-free Otsu and distance-transform baseline. Use it before transcript-to-cell assignment when no trusted segmentation exists. Do not use it for transcript-only assignment, or on a new stain before validation.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Segmentation method. cellpose is the learned default; watershed is the training-free baseline.

nuclear_channel.description: Channel of the stain image used to find nuclei, named as stored under images/<name>.

membrane_channel.description: Optional membrane or cytoplasm channel for whole-cell masks; null makes cell instances equal nuclear instances.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return the estimated time, memory and device without segmenting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

cellpose.description: Options for method cellpose; rejected when method is watershed.

model.description: Pretrained model name; the pinned default is recorded in uns/segmentation.

diameter_px.description: Expected cell diameter in pixels; null estimates it from the image.

flow_threshold.description: Maximum flow error for a kept mask.

cellprob_threshold.description: Cell-probability cut; pixels below it do not form masks.

min_size_px.description: Discard masks smaller than this many pixels; -1 disables the filter.

niter.description: Flow dynamics iterations; null uses the package's automatic value.

resample.description: Apply flow dynamics at the original image size rather than a resampled size.

watershed.description: Options for method watershed; rejected when method is cellpose.

threshold.description: Foreground threshold on the nuclear channel; null uses Otsu's method.

footprint.description: Side in pixels of the square footprint that finds distance maxima.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: computed inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: scheduled as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. labels/cell_instances. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, model, n_nuclei, n_cells, cells_without_nucleus, median_cell_area_um2, device. Never raw masks.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
